title: Application registry primitive, catalog metadata, and design-code context

supportingSourceFiles.coverage: root public exports for the migrated registry, catalog, and code context
existing structural application fixture used by registry parity tests

independentValidation.method: Strict declaration consumer coverage and independently executed pinned JavaScript versus built TypeScript registry, catalog, design-code, serialized-output, Unicode-string, and error-behavior comparisons.

tolerances.serializedParity: exact JSON serialization for catalog, manifests, placeholder results, and design-code context
tolerances.numericParity: absolute and relative tolerance 1e-12 where numerical values are encountered
tolerances.publicStrings: exact equality plus Unicode code-point equality

parityDifferences: The slice adds explicit TypeScript declarations and preserves source runtime validation, insertion order, null lookup behavior, duplicate-registration errors, unknown-application errors, catalog maturity values, and serialized design-code fields.
The source default application factory and its dependent application entrypoints remain outside this bounded slice and are still tracked as incomplete inventory items.
engineeringFunctionality: Strict solver-neutral registry and metadata primitives only; no application calculations, formulas, normative identifiers, or application maturity statuses are changed.
